LibreChurch Stack

A good service starts here.

Prepare a church service in your browser, then bring it to the room with SyncShow for Windows, macOS, or Linux.

Prepare online PreviewDownload SyncShow ↗Source code

Start in your browser

Open a portable service or start from scratch. Add sections, text slides, and blanks, and arrange your service.

Keep your work with you

Your files stay on your device. Download a service file to continue on another computer; no account or church server is needed.

Present with SyncShow

Use the desktop app for advanced editing, songs, Scripture, media, and coordinated venue screens.

Prepare online is a preview with a focused set of editing tools. Supported advanced content stays in your file; edit it in the desktop app. For the current public SyncShow download, save with the .syncshow-service option. The newer .libreshow extension uses the same archive and is available for newer desktop builds.
